definitions.explanation: A video communication platform used for online meetings, webinars, and virtual events.

examples.japanese: Zoomの{画面|がめん}を{共有|きょうゆう}してください。
コロナ{禍|か}でZoomを{使|つか}ったオンライン{授業|じゅぎょう}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: During the COVID pandemic, online classes using Zoom increased.

notes:
Zoom became widely used in Japan during the COVID-19 pandemic for remote work, online education, and virtual social gatherings.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- Zoom{会議|かいぎ}: Zoom meeting
- Zoom{飲|の}み{会|かい}: Zoom drinking party (online social gathering)
- Zoom{授業|じゅぎょう}: Zoom class/lecture
- Zoom{面接|めんせつ}: Zoom interview
- Zoom{疲|づか}れ: Zoom fatigue

USAGE NOTES:
- Zoom is often used as a verb: 「ズームする」(to have a Zoom meeting)
- The term 「オンライン{会議|かいぎ}」(online meeting) is used generically
- Zoom{背景|はいけい} (Zoom background) refers to virtual backgrounds

Zoom is written in English or as ズーム in Japanese text.
